messages:
maria: heads up — vendor released polaris-13b (open checkpoint). want a quick perf intake + triage to decide if we should onboard to hosted catalog. priority: perf + quant cost win, then quality check. :eyes:

raj: can do. what's the target SLO? p95 < 120ms for 1k tok?

maria: target is p95 <= 150ms for 1024 tokens at 1x batch on our DEDICATED A100 pool. but also want cost/throughput profiles for batching to find sweet spot. quality bar: no >5% regressions on conversational_cohort_v2.

raj: ok. propose initial benchmarks:
- latency sweep: ctx = [128, 512, 1024, 2048]
- batch = [1,2,4,8,16] (but cap when mem hits >90%)
- precision: fp16 baseline, int8 (q8_dynamic) and int8+KV cache test
- devices: a100-80gb, t4-16gb (for cost-sense)

oliver: adding infra checklist:
- ensure model artifacts converted w/ tokenizer sanity check
- run warmup passes to fill KV cache for ctx>512
- measure p50/p95/p99 and throughput (tokens/s)

raj: also check tokenization length mismatch vs our eval prompts — polaris uses a slightly different BPE. run `python token_check.py --model polaris-13b --dataset conversational_cohort_v2`

sophia: quick note on quant: last time int8 on this family increased hallucinations on long-context Q->A. we should add targeted evals: long_context_coherence and factuality_smoke.

maria: good call. add to quality checklist: long_context_coherence, retrieval-based QA smoke, and a small reward-model based scoring run (if time).

raj: scheduling bench jobs now. using bench harness snippet:
```
bench-run --model polaris-13b --devices a100-80gb --batches 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 128,512,1024,2048 --precision fp16,int8 --warmup 50 --measure p50,p95,p99,throughput
```

bench-bot: queued bench job #1245 for polaris-13b on a100 cluster. estimated runtime 3h. link: https://bench.internal/1245

perf-bot: perf ticket created ML-PERF-341. assignees suggested: @raj @oliver. tags: onboarding, quant, latency.

oliver: i'll provision a small canary pool and enable KV cache toggle flags. raj — please include memory profile dumps for batch sizes so we can set autoscale thresholds.

raj: will attach mem graphs and slot occupancy CSVs. also we'll run an int8 fallback stress run: intentionally saturate batch until QoS violation to find graceful degradation point.

maria: priority = high for eval and bench, but defer public catalog listing until quality pass completes. once bench results in, i'll run cost analysis and decide. thanks team. :thumbsup:
